verdict.rationale: Domains registered through Cloudflare Registrar automatically use Cloudflare's nameservers, so authoritative DNS hosting is included. A Cloudflare employee notes changes propagate in about 15 seconds, and DNSSEC is one-click and free. Users confirm the bundling, though they frame it as mandatory lock-in. On management, one user reports that letting a third party edit DNS requires an account-wide API key, which counts as friction. Missing for 10: any evidence on supported record types, any documentation of minimum or low TTL values, and evidence that the DNS management UI is developer-friendly.
